Once upon a time:
, there was a big mountain. On top of the mountain, there was a small house. In the house, a boy named Tom lived with his mom and dad. They were a happy family.
One day, Tom wanted to go up the mountain. He asked his mom and dad, "Can I go up the mountain?" His mom said, "Yes, but be careful." Tom was happy and started his trip up the mountain.
As Tom went up the mountain, he saw something disgusting. It was a big, yucky bug. Tom did not like the bug. He wanted to go back down. He asked his mom and dad for help. They took the bug away. Tom and his family went back down the mountain, safe and happy.

, in a small town, there was a little girl named Lucy. Lucy loved to play with her soft toys. One day, she saw a tiny spark on her toy bear. She looked closer and saw that it was a tiny spark. Lucy wanted to make the bear more shiny, so she decided to polish the bear.
Lucy took a soft cloth and gently rubbed the bear's eyes, ears, and tail. She worked hard to make sure the bear was shining. As she polished the bear, her friend Timmy came over and asked, "What are you doing, Lucy?"
"I'm making my bear shiny!" Lucy said proudly. "But I'm not good at polishing, and my bear is too small." Timmy looked at her bear and saw the spark shining in its eyes. He smiled and said, "Your bear is very pretty, Lucy."
Lucy felt happy that her bear was shiny. She thanked Timmy for his help, and they played together all day long. From that day on, Lucy and Timmy became best friends. They always took care of each other's toys, and they were never lonely again.
